**Switching to slim may break npm ci if native addons or git are needed—please verify.**

Slim images often omit python3, make, g++, and git required by node-gyp or git-based deps. If any native modules are in your workspace, npm ci will fail on slim. Consider a multi-stage build (builder installs build deps; runtime stays slim), or install the minimal toolchain in a builder stage.


Run this repo-scoped check to spot likely native modules:



If any matches appear, adopt a multi-stage Dockerfile (example below). I can tailor it for your monorepo if you share constraints.

[ suggest_recommended_refactor ][ offer_assistance ]

```Dockerfile
# Builder with toolchain
FROM node:22-bookworm AS builder
WORKDIR /app
RUN useradd -d /app -m typeberry
USER typeberry

COPY --chown=typeberry:typeberry package*.json ./
COPY --chown=typeberry:typeberry tsconfig.json ./
COPY --chown=typeberry:typeberry bin/ ./bin/
COPY --chown=typeberry:typeberry packages/ ./packages/
RUN npm ci

# Optionally build TS -> JS here if applicable
# RUN npm run build

# Runtime stays slim
FROM node:22-bookworm-slim
WORKDIR /app
RUN useradd -d /app -m typeberry
USER typeberry
```
